# Faq

## Frequently Asked Questions and Tips

### Frequently asked questions

**Can
[*Projects*](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#project)
include multiple
[*methods*](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#method)?**

- Yes,
  [*Projects*](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#project)
  can include multiple
  [*methods*](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#method).

**Can
[*Syntheses*](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#synthesissyntheses)
include multiple
[*methods*](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#method)?**

- No,
  [*Synthesis*](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#synthesissyntheses)
  must only contain one
  [*method*](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#method).
  Separate
  [*Syntheses*](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#synthesissyntheses)
  must be made for different
  [*methods*](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#method).

**If I am uploading for someone else what information do I need to get
from the custodian?**

- [*Here*](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gtMNcZZqBqG3ylUPD68KqdbANHUKfVJ0XXHdkySHXRk/edit?gid=0#gid=0)
  is a spreadsheet to get the custodian to fill out
